When visiting the historic city of Hanoi, one cannot help but be captivated by its timeless charm and rich culinary offerings, among which Shrimp Cake stands out as a beloved local delicacy that has enchanted visitors for generations. This delightful dish, known locally as "bánh tôm," is a testament to the culinary ingenuity of Hanoi's residents, combining simple ingredients into a complex and satisfying treat that is both crispy and savory.

For those seeking a more traditional setting, Bánh tôm Bà Lộc offers a taste of old Hanoi with its charming ambiance and classic dishes. Unlike some other establishments, the Shrimp Cakes here are cut into smaller pieces, making them easier to handle and enjoy.

In the bustling area of Quảng An, Bánh tôm Thành Ngân provides a spacious and airy setting for enjoying Shrimp Cake. The restaurant’s layout, adorned with lush greenery and simple yet well-arranged furniture, creates a serene environment conducive to social gatherings.

Nearby, Bánh tôm Bích Phúc on Lê Đại Hành offers a more casual dining experience, with its outdoor seating along the street providing a lively backdrop for enjoying the Shrimp Cakes. The cakes here are known for their large, plump shrimp that are fried to perfection, resulting in a crispy exterior and a tender, juicy interior.

Originating from the early 1930s, Shrimp Cake has become synonymous with the vibrant food scene of Hanoi, particularly around the picturesque West Lake. This delicacy, known locally as Bánh Tôm Hồ Tây, is not only a testament to the culinary prowess of the region but also a nostalgic reminder of simpler times for many residents.
